decision: BLACKBOARD 2026-10-09 (review N5): a fixed Intel-vendor x86-64-v2 profile (SSE through SSE4.2, POPCNT, CMPXCHG16B, LAHF/SAHF in 64-bit mode; no AVX, no AVX-512, no XSAVE) until a game needs more

sources.sdm: Intel SDM Vol 2A, CPUID: leaf layouts and feature bit positions; 'If a value entered for CPUID.EAX is higher than the maximum input value for basic or extended function for that processor then the data for the highest basic information leaf is returned'
sources.psabi: x86-64 psABI micro-architecture levels: x86-64-v2 = CMPXCHG16B, LAHF-SAHF, POPCNT, SSE3, SSE4.1, SSE4.2, SSSE3
sources.family_model: Intel Core i3-6100 (Skylake, family 6, model 0x5E, stepping 3), Hail to the Rainbow's minimum CPU on its Steam page; it has AVX2, which this profile does not report

leaves.note: max basic leaf 7; vendor GenuineIntel as EBX 'Genu', EDX 'ineI', ECX 'ntel'

EAX 0x000506E3 (family 6, model 0x5E, stepping 3); EBX CLFLUSH line 8 x 8 bytes, one logical processor, APIC id 0; ECX SSE3 0, SSSE3 9, CX16 13, SSE4.1 19, SSE4.2 20, POPCNT 23 (no OSXSAVE 27, AVX 28, hypervisor 31); EDX FPU through APIC 0-9, SEP 11, MTRR 12, PGE 13, MCA 14, CMOV 15, PAT 16, PSE36 17, CLFSH 19, MMX 23, FXSR 24, SSE 25, SSE2 26
max subleaf 0; no structured extended features (no BMI1/2, AVX2, AVX-512, ERMS)
0x80000001: ECX LAHF/SAHF 0; EDX SYSCALL 11, NX 20, LM 29
0x80000002: brand string bytes 0-15 of 'w2m x86-64-v2 guest', NUL-padded to 48
0x80000003: brand string bytes 16-31 of 'w2m x86-64-v2 guest', NUL-padded to 48
0x80000004: brand string bytes 32-47 of 'w2m x86-64-v2 guest', NUL-padded to 48
0x80000006: L2 256 KB, 8-way (code 6), 64-byte lines, as the i3-6100
